text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer with Malignant Ascites and Pleural Effusion (Pseudomyxoma Peritonei or Peritoneal Carcinomatosis). The clinical triad of shortness of breath, rapid abdominal girth increase, and a large ovarian mass in a 40-year-old woman, combined with the requested imaging showing likely ascites and pleural involvement, is highly specific for advanced ovarian malignancy.
